title: Protest Documentation Share Schedule — Amended Wage Reports (Employer Benefit Charging)
content:
| Amended wage reports the employer filed within the last twelve (12) months | Protest documentation share |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 1.00 — the whole |
| 1 to 3 | 0.50 — one half |
| None | 0.00 — zero |

This schedule applies to a written protest of Employer Benefit Charging charges that disputes the employer's base-period wages or its base-period status. The protest documentation share is the whole when the amended wage reports the employer filed within the last twelve months number at least four, one half when they number one to three, and zero when it filed none in that time.

## Notes to the schedule

1. **What is counted.** The quarterly contribution and wage reports of report type amended on the employer's Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts record, each report counted once, by its filed date. Original and final reports are not counted.
2. **The twelve months.** The twelve months run back from the day the protest is lodged. A report counts while fewer than twelve whole months separate its filed date from that day: with a protest lodged on 10 October, a report filed on 11 October of the previous year counts, and one filed on 10 October of the previous year does not.
3. **Thresholds.** The figure turns on 4 and on 1: three amended reports give one half (0.50), a fourth gives the whole (1.00); one amended report gives one half (0.50), none gives zero (0.00).

## Hypothetical counts

| Amended reports in the twelve months | Share |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0.00 |
| 1 | 0.50 |
| 3 | 0.50 |
| 4 | 1.00 |
| 6 | 1.00 |
